sources.title: Apps
sources.description: Which pick'em apps to read. Both = line shopping between them.

sports.title: Sports
sports.description: Optional. e.g. NFL, CFB, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, CBB, SOCCER, TENNIS, MMA, CS. Empty = every sport.

players.title: Players
players.description: Optional. Player names or parts of names, e.g. Josh Allen, McCaffrey.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Optional. e.g. Passing Yards, Receptions, Points, Shots, Strikeouts. Either app's wording works (Rec Yds = Receiving Yards).

includeAlternates.title: Include alternate lines
includeAlternates.description: Also return Underdog's alternate and Sleeper's non-standard lines. Off = the main line per player and stat.

maxRows.title: Maximum lines
maxRows.description: Stop after this many lines. A full slate across all sports is several thousand.
